dialogues.speaker: Winfried
dialogues.text: Um, at 8th Coy, we're responsible for a variety of battlefield support operations, including emergency medical treatment.

dialogues.speaker: Winfried
dialogues.text: But each time I treat the Grand Master's injuries, I end up questioning everything I know about first-aid.

dialogues.speaker: Winfried
dialogues.text: Either I'm taken aback by how he only managed to end up with minor injuries after a fierce battle, or I'm astonished by how someone with such severe wounds is still on his feet.
